This is Ripple. One news story can move many stocks. Ripple shows which ones, and why.
It runs on a map of the economy: 79 parts and 170 cause-and-effect links, stored in FalkorDB.
Let's try it. Paste a headline, or pick an example.
Headline: the Fed will keep interest rates high.
Ripple gives a plain answer first: which stocks are likely to rise or fall, and when.
Click through the chain step by step. Every step has a written reason. Nothing is made up.
Every stock name is clickable. Let's open Toll Brothers, a home builder.
This page shows everything that can push this one stock up or down.
Open a row to see the chain: higher rates make mortgages cost more, so fewer homes sell.
It also shows past calls on this stock, and similar stocks.
Can you trust it? We tested it on 10 real news events from 2026.
35 of 50 calls were right after 20 trading days. Random picks: about half.
Every single call is listed here, right or wrong. Small test, so we say so.
And it runs by itself. Every 2 hours, a free robot reads the news and makes new calls.
Each call gets graded against the real market, in public. Mistakes stay on the record.
Ripple: see where the news lands. Try it at ripple-beta-five.vercel.app
